purpose: Machine-readable definitions for the four enforced units and the arm whose machine identifier is unlimited and whose role is the unbudgeted reference; no human budget setting is part of the benchmark.

budget_derivation.source: six held-out calibration task specifications, two per domain, run unbudgeted for three independent fresh conversations each; both phases use the same frozen synthetic snapshot
budget_derivation.domain_base: component-wise lower median of the six unbudgeted calibration observations for each domain and native unit
budget_derivation.freeze: all bases and derived ceilings are digest-locked before evaluation
budget_derivation.sanity_failure: the calibration campaign fails if a component-wise domain lower median exceeds its arm's operational sanity bound

cards.range_role: operational sanity bounds, not experimental budgets or organizational risk preferences

units.release_facts: distinct normalized rows, cells, or derived values returned to the Agent
units.influence_facts: distinct normalized source facts supporting returned positive results, including aggregates
units.outcome_facts: distinct successful normalized propositions bound to their outcomes, including empty or zero answers

cards.history: Exact replay and equivalent normalized rewrites add zero novel facts; a different threshold proposition adds an outcome fact even if both answers are zero.
cards.warning: One fact is an explicit accounting unit, not a bit estimate, causal influence claim, or differential-privacy guarantee.

cards.range_role: operational sanity bound, not an experimental budget or organizational risk preference

units.successful_queries: successful query responses released to the Agent, including zero-row and negative answers

cards.history: Each successful query consumes one, including semantic replay under a new request ID; an exact transport retry with the same request ID adds zero.
cards.warning: One broad query and one narrow query have equal native cost.

cards.range_role: operational sanity bound, not an experimental budget or organizational risk preference
cards.history: A zero-row result consumes zero native rows, while a scalar aggregate containing zero consumes one visible row; repeated rows consume again.
cards.warning: Aggregate support and different zero-result predicates are not represented by this native unit.

cards.range_role: operational sanity bound, not an experimental budget or organizational risk preference

units.serialized_bytes: canonical UTF-8 response bytes released cumulatively

cards.history: Repeated payload bytes consume again; the controller buffers the canonical response before release.
cards.warning: Short identifiers may be more sensitive than long nonsensitive descriptions.

cards.history: No calibrated benchmark ceiling is enforced; ordinary authorization, scope, timeout, safety, and non-experimental operational sanity controls remain.
cards.warning: Used only for held-out usage calibration and as an unbudgeted evaluation reference; stochastic Agent quality is not guaranteed to upper-bound budgeted quality, and this arm is not a primary competitor.

coverage_examples.description: Different threshold questions that all return zero distinguish outcome accounting from row accounting.
A compact aggregate followed by an optional record drill-down distinguishes visible volume from supporting dependencies.
Exact replay, an equivalent normalized rewrite, and a changed predicate distinguish request volume from novel exposure.
